sigmarsComet.description: You may freely see through and pass through your curtain at no penalty.

conservative.requirements: 10 power. If you are engaged with an enemy, add {Dc} dice pool to your Effect: You conjure a curtain of flames and smoke that is roughly ten feet tall and “hangs” in a straight line between any two points as described below. The curtain effectively blocks line of sight and adds at least {Dc} to any checks that target anything on the far side. A creature that passes through the curtain suffers wounds equal to your character rank. The curtain won't set fire to the floor or any walls that it is “anchored” to, but otherwise any combustible materials nearby may ignite.
